description: Add a daily cost bar chart with an overlaid cost-per-ship trend line to the Dashboard Productivity zone, and establish the reusable dashboard chart baseline (pinned first-party SVG kit, theme-token colors, three-state wrapper, a11y wrapper, transform-based motion) that future charts compose against.

tasks.title: Add per-day cumulative cost-per-ship series to the agent-usage surface (server)
tasks.description: Extend AgentUsageTimeseriesDto with an additive CumulativeCostPerShip sibling array aligned 1:1 by day with the existing Buckets[] (same window, same length), and add an AgentSessionQuerier method that computes prefix sums: preWindowSpend (lifetime sum of UsageSummary.CostAmount over sessions with usage whose CreatedAt < rangeFrom) and preWindowShipped (count of done issues whose CompletedAt < rangeFrom, via IssueQuerier), then walks the 7-day window deriving cumulative cost, cumulative shipped count, and cost-per-ship per day. Model cost-per-ship as double? preserving null-vs-zero semantics (null = undefined when shipped==0; 0 = genuine free shipping). The existing Buckets[] timeseries, the /agent/cost rollup, and all rollup fields remain unchanged; the series is strictly additive and introduces no new events, writes, or data collection.
acceptanceCriteria: CumulativeCostPerShip is returned alongside the existing Buckets[] on /api/projects/{projectRef}/agent/usage, sharing the same trailing window and array length

Each day's cumulative cost equals the sum of UsageSummary.CostAmount over all sessions with usage created on or before the end of that day; cumulative shipped count equals the count of issues whose CompletedAt is on or before the end of that day; costPerShip for the day is cumulative cost divided by cumulative shipped count
A day whose cumulative shipped count is zero yields a null (undefined) cost-per-ship, serialized distinctly from a genuine zero (cumulative cost 0 with shipped > 0)
The existing totalCost, todayCost, doneIssuesCount, costPerShip rollup fields and the 7-day daily-bucket Buckets[] contract retain their existing semantics and shape unchanged
A zero-sample project (no sessions with usage or no shipped issues) returns 200 with the defined empty-per-day cumulative result, not an error and not a numeric zero for undefined days
An unknown project reference returns 404, consistent with the existing endpoints
The computation introduces no new event, state collection, session-domain write, or issue-domain write

npm test (server, C# warnings-as-errors) passes, including extended AgentUsageTimeseriesApiSpecs.cs covering cumulative-series math, the undefined-vs-zero scenarios, the zero-sample 200 case, and the 404 case
tasks.output: Extended AgentUsageTimeseriesDto with CumulativeCostPerShip; new AgentSessionQuerier cumulative-series method; extended AgentUsageTimeseriesApiSpecs.cs tests
tasks.notes: Deploy server-first per the design migration plan via `mo update server`. Additive DTO field is safe for old-web/old-server either direction. Use IssueQuerier for done-issue completion counts (same source the /cost handler uses).

tasks.title: Establish the reusable dashboard chart baseline (web)
tasks.description: Build the reusable chart baseline under packages/web/src/pages/dashboard/charts/: a first-party SVG chart kit (BarSeries, LineSeries, ChartAxes, ChartLegend primitives) pinned as the single project-wide chart library with no external chart dependency added; ChartContainer three-state wrapper (loading/error/empty/resolved, mutually exclusive, with caller-supplied concrete next-action empty state, role=status and aria-live=polite); ChartAccessibility wrapper (role=img aria-label, sr-only textual data summary, shape-disambiguated legend that does not rely on color alone); useReducedMotion hook plus transform/opacity-only motion conventions (never animating width/height/layout); and a theme-token color contract sourced strictly from the existing --chart-* tokens. Extend tests/setup.ts matchMedia stub so individual tests can opt into prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
acceptanceCriteria: A single first-party SVG chart kit is pinned as the dashboard chart library; package.json gains no external charting dependency

ChartContainer renders exactly one of loading/error/empty/resolved at a time; the empty branch renders a caller-supplied concrete next action (never a bare 'no data'); loading and error use role=status / aria-live=polite

ChartAccessibility exposes a role=img concise aria-label plus an sr-only textual data summary describing series, window, and salient values, and a legend that disambiguates series by shape (label/shape/pattern), not color alone
Every color on the chart surface (series fills/strokes, axes, gridlines, legend, labels) resolves to --chart-* theme tokens; no hex/rgb/hsl/named color literals appear on the chart surface
Numeric labels (axes, data labels, legend figures) use tabular-nums
Bar-height and series-position changes animate via transform and/or opacity only; width/height/layout properties are never animated
When prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is set, chart animation is disabled or minimized while correct final values still render
Component tests cover three-state rendering, the accessibility wrapper (sr-only summary and non-color legend), transform-only motion, reduced-motion suppression, and theme-token color usage
npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass
tasks.output: packages/web/src/pages/dashboard/charts/ baseline components (chart kit primitives, ChartContainer, ChartAccessibility, useReducedMotion) plus component tests; extended tests/setup.ts matchMedia stub
tasks.notes: Dashboard-scoped placement because the spec scopes the baseline to dashboard charts. This is a reusable foundation with its own spec; it has no visible consumer until T-003 mounts the cost-trend widget, but is verifiable via its own component tests. The existing CompletionTrend.tsx hand-rolled SVG precedent informs the kit shape; it is not refactored by this task.

tasks.title: Mount the daily cost trend widget with cost-per-ship overlay (web)
tasks.description: Add the useAgentUsage query hook in entities/agent/api/agent-usage.ts mirroring entities/agent/api/cost-rollup.ts (same request<T> fetcher, projectApiPath, staleTime 60_000, query key ['agent','usage',projectId]), re-exported from entities/agent/index.ts. Build CostTrendChart.tsx in pages/dashboard/productivity/: one daily cost bar per trailing day with height encoding that day's token cost sourced from the existing Buckets[] timeseries (zero-cost day renders a zero-height bar, not a gap), overlaid with a cost-per-ship trend line sourced from the server cumulative series (skip null/undefined points; plot genuine zero at value 0), using a dual y-axis (left = daily cost currency, right = cost-per-ship currency/issue) with token-colored, clearly labeled axes and legend ordering matching axis assignment. The widget composes against the T-002 baseline (pinned kit, ChartContainer three-state routing with empty next action '...appear once an agent session reports usage on this project', ChartAccessibility sr-only summary and shape-based bar-vs-line legend, tabular-nums, transform-based motion honoring prefers-reduced-motion) and is purely read-only. Mount the widget in ProductivityZone.tsx after InvestmentPanel; InvestmentPanel scalar figures and presentation remain unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: One bar renders per trailing day with height encoding that day's cost sourced from the existing agent-usage Buckets[]; a day with zero cost renders a zero-height bar rather than omitting the day or collapsing the axis

The cost-per-ship trend line plots cumulative spend divided by cumulative shipped count per day sourced from the server per-day cumulative series (not computed client-side from a windowed-only sample)
Days with zero cumulative shipped count produce no plotted trend value (undefined), distinguishable from genuine zero (cumulative cost 0, shipped > 0) which plots at value 0
A dual y-axis renders with the left axis labeled as daily cost and the right axis labeled as cost-per-ship, each axis token-colored to match its series, with legend order matching axis assignment

Loading, error, and empty states route through the shared ChartContainer; the empty state names a concrete next action that the chart gains data once an agent session reports usage on the project; chart content does not render while loading or on error

The widget renders through the pinned chart kit, sources all colors from theme tokens, exposes the accessibility wrapper (sr-only data summary and a shape-based legend disambiguating bars from the trend line), uses tabular-nums for numeric labels, and animates via transform only while honoring prefers-reduced-motion

Viewing or refreshing the widget performs no write or mutation against issue, session, or workflow domain state and introduces no new backend write, event, or data collection beyond the additive cumulative series read
The existing InvestmentPanel scalar figures (totalCost, todayCost, costPerShip, doneIssuesCount) and their presentation remain unchanged

Tests cover bar values sourced from the timeseries, trend values sourced from the cumulative series including undefined-vs-zero handling, three-state routing through the shared wrapper, the empty-state next action, dual-axis rendering, token color usage, and reduced-motion behavior
npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass
